999008199.text: ふふ。この顔ぶれでのお茶会は、やはり格別ですわね

localizations.en: Hehe. A tea party with this particular company is always something special, isn't it?

999008199.text:
あら？　あなたには、ミーケとディオーナが
いるじゃないの？

localizations.en: Oh? But don't you have Mieke and Diona?

999008199.text:
友との親愛と臣下との絆は、異なるもの。
クリセルダなら、よく知っているでしょう？

localizations.en: Affection between friends and bonds with one's retainers are quite different things. You understand that well, don't you, Criselda?

999008199.text:
ええ。私たちは同志にして友。
だからこそ、このお茶会は得難いものだわ

localizations.en: Yes. We're comrades and friends. That's what makes these tea parties so precious.

999008199.text: 女子会っていうんだよな？

localizations.en: Isn't this what they call girls' time?

999008199.text: ええ。ルアッカとムラサキは遠慮してくださいな

localizations.en: Indeed. Though I'll have to ask you and Violet to excuse yourselves.

999008199.text:
言われなくても遠慮するさ。
こう見えて、作法は心得ているからね

localizations.en: We'll pass even without you telling us. Appearances aside, we do know proper etiquette.

999008199.text: 二人が、ごめんね？

いいのよ、アンチュ。さ、二人とも召し上がれ。
新作を用意してみたのだけど、どれが好きかしら？

localizations.en: It's fine, Antje. Now then, help yourselves. I've prepared some new treats. Which ones do you like?

999008199.text:
あら、かわいらしいクッキーですわね。
これは……木の実を混ぜ込んでいますのね？

localizations.en: My, what adorable cookies. Are these... mixed with nuts?

999008199.text:
ええ。軽い食感の木の実を薄く切って、
少し重めにした本体に混ぜ込んでみたの

localizations.en: Yes. I thinly sliced some light, crispy nuts and mixed them into a slightly denser base.

999008199.text:
軽妙な食感ながら、物足りなさを感じさせない采配。
ふふ。また腕を上げましたわね

localizations.en: A delightfully light texture without feeling insubstantial. Hehe. Your skills continue to improve.

999008199.text:
こっちは……もぐっ……
ふわふわでサクサク……

ふむ。ララは複雑な食感で、味が濃厚なもの、
アンチュは意外に軽い口当たりが好き……

localizations.en: I see. Lara prefers complex textures with rich flavors, while Antje surprisingly likes lighter textures...

999008199.text: ね、ねえ。クリセルダは何が一番好き？

localizations.en: H-hey. Which one do you like best, Criselda?

999008199.text: え、私？

だ、だって……作ったクリセルダは
どれが一番お気に入りなのか知りたくて……

localizations.en: W-well... I wanted to know which one's your favorite since you made them...

999008199.text:
うーん、そうね。このほろ苦さは、我ながら
作っていて癖になったわね

localizations.en: Hmm, let's see. I must admit, even I found myself getting attached to this bittersweet flavor while making it.

999008199.text: ほろ苦さ……

そうそう。こっちの食感も、なかなか上手くいったと
思うのよ。パリッとしつつ、中はホロッとね

localizations.en: Yes, yes. And I think the texture on this one turned out quite well too. Crisp on the outside, but crumbly inside.

999008199.text: パリッと……ホロホロ……

クリセルダは以前から、お茶会のたびに
お菓子を手ずから振る舞ってくれましたわね

localizations.en: You've always served us handmade sweets at our tea parties, haven't you?

999008199.text: ええ。かわいくて美味しいものを作るのは楽しいもの

localizations.en: Yes. Making cute and delicious things is enjoyable.

999008199.text:
それをこうして、かわいい子たちが食べてくれる姿を
間近で見られるのは本望ね

localizations.en: And being able to watch such adorable people enjoy them up close is deeply satisfying.

999008199.text: あら。わたくしまでかわいいと？

localizations.en: Oh my. You're calling me adorable as well?

999008199.text: 美しさとかわいらしさは同時に成り立つものね

localizations.en: Beauty and adorableness can coexist, you know.

999008199.text:
はぁ。相変わらずの人たらしですわね。
錬金党に迎えられた当初は、驚きましたのよ？

localizations.en: My goodness. You're still such a charmer. I was quite surprised when I first joined the alchemists, you know?

999008199.text:
怜悧なあなたが、進んでかわいらしいお菓子や料理を
振る舞う姿は、あまりに意外でしたもの

localizations.en: Seeing someone as shrewd as you willingly serve cute sweets and meals was completely unexpected.

999008199.text: あら。私の印象なんて、私自身は関知できないものよ？

localizations.en: Oh my. How others perceive me is beyond my control, isn't it?

999008199.text:
ふふ。渇望一筋の人生でなければ、意外と今頃、
いいお嫁さんになっていたかもしれませんね

localizations.en: Hehe. If not for your single-minded pursuit, you might have made quite the lovely bride by now.

999008199.text: ク、クリセルダは……お嫁さんになりたいの？

localizations.en: C-Criselda... do you want to be a bride?

999008199.text: うっ！　そ、その上目遣いは反則よ

localizations.en: Ah! T-that upward glance is cheating.

999008199.text:
私はアンチュのような、かわいい子のお嫁さんになら
なりたいわ

localizations.en: I'd want to be the bride of someone as adorable as you, Antje.

999008199.text: えへへ……じゃあ、クリセルダのお婿さんになるわ

localizations.en: Ehehe... Then I'll be your groom, Criselda.

999008199.text: ふふ

元「極夜の錬金党」の錬金術士。現在は
「ララ・キングダム」の王として精力的に活動している

localizations.en: A former Polar Night Alchemist. Currently working energetically as the queen of the Kingdom of Lara.
